notes.title: Postponing the release of CG: Girls 3 to 2026.
notes.notes:
In the two months since the announcement of CG: Girls 3, the number of people who added the game to their Wishlist is twice less than the number of people who added CG: Girls 2 during the same period. Based on this data, it was decided to postpone the release of the game to Q1 2026 (tentatively the end of January).

In the meantime, you can add a new game to your Wishlist - Coloring Game 10K.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3759780/Coloring_Game_10K/


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3525390/Coloring_Game_Girls_3/
